facts.text: A giant tan teddy bear sat on the stage with its legs stretched out.
The banner behind the bear said "Cal Hacks 13.0".
The bear's feet had white pads with brown paw prints.
The banner showed a cartoon bear flying a red airplane.
The banner read "october 23-25, 2026 | san francisco, ca".
The banner had a dark blue night sky with yellow stars and clouds.
A white chair with gold legs stood at the right side of the stage.
A black curtain hung behind the banner.
A coil of black cable lay on the stage floor near the front right.

sessions.note: They didn't say anything during this session.
